sources.snippet: The planned execution of Nidal Hasan is scheduled to be the first military execution in more than 60 years.
sources.title: Trump calls off livestream for Fort Hood shooter's execution by firing squad

sources.snippet: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth last week announced plans to livestream the firing squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan, triggering a backlash among Republicans in Congress, religious leaders and international observers. The event would be extraordinary, even for a country that has long employed capital punishment. A government execution has never been broadcast or livestreamed, according to death penalty experts, and the US military ​has not executed anyone by firing squad since 1945. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Commentator Douglas Herbert tells us more.
